termsServiceText: We sell digital credit packages used to generate AI videos from drawings uploaded by the user.
termsRightsText: You own the generated video, provided you own the rights to the original drawing. Audio tracks remain under a non-exclusive license.
termsResponsibilityText: You guarantee that you have legal consent, as parent or legal guardian, for any image of a minor. Uploading images of third parties or public figures to create deepfakes or defamatory content is strictly forbidden.
termsRefundText: Credits are digital goods with instant access. ALL SALES ARE FINAL AND NON-REFUNDABLE IN CASH once purchased, including unused or partially used credits.
faqQ1: What happens if generation fails due to a technical error?
faqA1: If our system or the AI API encounters a server error or timeout, your credit is NOT deducted (or is automatically restored). You can retry at no extra cost.
faqQ2: Can I get a cash refund for unused credits?
faqA2: No. As digital credit packages are instantly credited to your wallet upon purchase, all sales are final and non-refundable.
faqA3: You own the generated video as long as you own the rights to the original drawing. Audio is under a non-exclusive license.
faqQ4: Can I upload images of children or public figures?
faqA4: For minors, you must be the parent or legal guardian. Uploading images of third parties or public figures without consent is strictly prohibited.
